title: Where an order goes
lede: Two paths through one shop: placing an order, and refunding it.

app.label: Shop app
app.description: The customer's shop app, on a phone or in a browser.

orders.label: Order service
orders.description: Takes the cart, checks stock and price, and turns it into an order. It also handles refunds.

support.label: Support desk
support.description: Where refund requests are checked by a person against the returns policy.

psp.label: Card processor
psp.description: The card processor, run by a payment partner. It authorises charges and sends refunds back to the card.

wms.label: Warehouse
wms.description: The warehouse system. A confirmed order becomes a pick list, then a parcel.

paths.name: Order path
paths.summary: A paid order turns into a parcel.

steps.title: The customer checks out
steps.text: The app sends the cart, the address and the chosen delivery option to the order service.

steps.title: The card is charged
steps.text: The order service asks the card processor to authorise the total.

steps.title: The payment comes back
steps.text: An approved payment confirms the order; a declined one returns the customer to checkout.

steps.title: The warehouse ships it
steps.text: A confirmed order becomes a pick list for the warehouse.

paths.name: Refund path
paths.summary: A refund is checked by a person before money moves.

steps.title: The customer asks
steps.text: From the order page, the customer asks for a refund and says why.

steps.title: Support approves it
steps.text: A support agent checks the request against the returns policy.

steps.title: The money goes back
steps.label: refund card
steps.text: The order service tells the card processor to refund the original card.
